dct_description_sm: This research focuses on the role of natural disturbance agents and the implications they have on forest structure and processes. We are also investigating how these disturbances are responding to a changing climate and what implications this might have on the future of forests at the northern edge of their range. Using dendrochronology, past disturbance regimes of these forests will be reconstructed and the role of past disturbances on the present and future forests will be explored. By understanding the scale and intensity of disturbance regimes, we have knowledge of how sensitive and resilient these landscapes are to climate change.
dct_title_s: Role of natural disturbance agents on the dendrology and forest structure data from the Mealy Mountains, Labrador
